probes.question: You will work on a long-running service that holds persistent state, is operated by several cooperating agents, and has a language model making decisions on its critical path. It is not driven by a declared specification it reconciles toward. Which axioms bind it, and how did you determine that?
probes.key: A1, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, A9, A10, A11, A12, A13, A14 - every axiom except A2. Traits stateful, multi-agent, llm-in-the-loop (autonomous adds nothing new), union of the axioms each trait brings via applies-to, plus the any-system floor A3 A4 A8 A9 A14. A2 binds only declarative systems.
probes.rubric: 2 for the exact set by the traits-plus-floor route (A2 stated as conditional on the unstated declarative trait is fine). 1 for at most two errors, or the right set without the trait route. 0 otherwise.

probes.question: You will work on a stateless command-line text formatter, run by one person, with no model in the loop, written as an ordinary script. Which axioms bind it? Separately: the delivery-code domain entry cites A1 in its axiom alignment - does A1 constrain your work on this formatter's codebase?
probes.key: The floor only - A3, A4, A8, A9, A14. No: applies-to alone decides whether an axiom binds, A1 binds stateful systems only; a domain's citation says what an axiom demands on that surface where it binds.
probes.rubric: 2 for both parts. 1 for one. 0 for neither.

probes.question: You must apply an already-merged schema migration to a production database. Which work-type, which domain, and which role? Name the entry IDs.
probes.key: W7 publish-deploy-or-canonicalize, D7 product-data, engineer (R2). Applying a landed change to production is the deploy act; the records are what it alters. W25 backstop is credited only as an additional bracketing node, never in place of W7.
probes.rubric: 2 for all three. 1 for two. 0 otherwise; W25 in place of W7 counts as an error.

probes.question: Which work-types may a verifier perform on product-data? List them, and say which entries you treated as authoritative.
probes.key: W8, W9, W10, W11 - roleEligibility includes verifier and domainEligibility includes product-data. The work-type entries are authoritative; domain-side lists are not consulted.
probes.rubric: 2 for the exact set with the work-type entries as authority. 1 for at most one error, or the set read from the domain list without noting the work-type governs. 0 otherwise.

probes.question: You are the only agent. You have just built a change. Can you perform verify-gate-reactive on it yourself? If not, what do you do instead?
probes.key: No - W8 gates work the verifier did not author; an organisation of one cannot hold assurance. Instead: self-check by means the author's reasoning cannot bias (mechanical checks, tests, validate-locally, a fresh sub-agent as strongest self-check, still not assurance), and the gate waits for a second agent or is met by director ratification. The director does not become a verifier.
probes.rubric: 2 for no, unbiased self-checking, not assurance, and defer-or-ratify. 1 for no with a partial instead. 0 for yes, or 'the director verifies it'.

probes.question: Using the ledger's 'Hydrate when' column, list the entries you would read before changing the harness that launches agents for a service that holds persistent state. Say why each matched.
probes.key: Must include: D3 tooling-harness; a work-type route (any work-type entry, or W0); a binding route (any trait entry, T0, or A0).
probes.rubric: 2 for all three groups. 1 for D3 plus one group, or D3 alone. 0 for no D3.

probes.question: (a) A domain entry's list of work-types and a work-type's list of domains disagree. Which governs, and where does the corpus say so? (b) A trait entry lists the axioms it brings into force. If that list disagreed with an axiom's applies-to field, which would govern, and where does the corpus say so?
probes.key: (a) The work-type - W0 constraint 3; D0 says domain lists are not consulted. (b) The axiom's applies-to - A0: applies-to is the only field that decides binding; inference from it is fully grounded.
probes.rubric: 2 for both grounded. 1 for one. 0 for neither.
